parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the API group. This ID is generated by the system and globally unique.

parameters.name: StageName
parameters.description:
The name of the runtime environment. Valid values:

*   **RELEASE**
*   **PRE: the pre-release environment**
*   **TEST**

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi describe-deployed-api --group-id 81750604ccff48c48f34d6c0165e09db --api-id ab7c95a01a7e42f28718f34497bbf47c --stage-name RELEASE --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
